**Incident: Gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** dep-4471 (gateway, a.novak) — "config: connection-per-request for pool isolation." Config generation 118→119, flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true`. Each request now claim own DB connection instead of share; fixed pool size (20) exhaust fast under load. Every 503 pair `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting N)`.

**Impact window:** Start 2026-03-14T02:14:18.972Z (first 503, req-07401, /v1/cart→billing-svc). 19 sec after dep-4471 finish (02:14:00Z). Still ongoing as of last log entry 03:59:27.974Z — no recovery, `waiting` queue climb 13 → 74+, never drain. Scope: gateway only. Worker pool (separate, size 8) unaffected — jobs run clean whole window, no error rise.

**Rollback:** dep-4471 (gateway). Revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false`, or raise pool size if per-request model wanted kept — dep author a.novak, deploy pipeline gen 119.

**Note:** dep-4472 (billing-svc, 02:41) and dep-4473 (catalog-svc, 03:20) ship during incident window but unrelated — no config/pool change, not suspect.
